preconditions.description: The number of elements in the sequence is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**5 for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence is between 1 and 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output string has the same length as the number of elements in the sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '123' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string is either '1', '2', or '3'.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == '3' for i in range(len(stdout)) if all(a[i] not in lis for lis in longest_increasing_subsequences))
postconditions.description: An element belongs to group 3 if it is in every longest increasing subsequence.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == '2' for i in range(len(stdout)) if any(a[i] in lis for lis in longest_increasing_subsequences) and not all(a[i] in lis for lis in longest_increasing_subsequences))
postconditions.description: An element belongs to group 2 if it is in at least one but not every longest increasing subsequence.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == '1' for i in range(len(stdout)) if all(a[i] not in lis for lis in longest_increasing_subsequences))
postconditions.description: An element belongs to group 1 if it is in no longest increasing subsequence.
